Fear & Courage

You’re already welcome here. Rest first; then let one verse land.

If your chest feels tight or your thoughts won’t quiet, you don’t have to figure it all out here. Scripture meets fear with steadiness — KJV on this page.

No rush. Read slowly. Let one verse land.

Key Verses

Isaiah 41:10

Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God.

2 Timothy 1:7

For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

1 John 4:18

There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear.

A Gentle Word

Isaiah 41:10 — not “be brave.” Just “I am with thee.” That’s the whole thing.
